In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
conjugation is not a prerequisite for adaptive reversion, although it is a prerequisite for adaptive transfer of the reversion.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
adaptive reversion of a frameshift mutation in a strain of E. coli requires the RecA-RecBCD pathway and is facilitated by conjugal functions but does not require conjugation.
the adaptive reversion of lacZ alleles is dependent on recombination, but not on the transfer of the episomal allele.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the RecA-dependent pathway for adaptive mutagenesis can operate on episomal DNA in the absence of conjugal functions.
the RecA-RecBCD pathway for homologous recombination is required for adaptive recombination of an episomal mutation.
the adaptive reversion of a frameshift mutation on an episome can be studied without the need to control conjugation.
